topic: AI/ML-Based Optimization of Multipliers or Arithmetic Units via Design Generation and Synthesis Enhancement
topic_description: The topic focuses on the optimization of multipliers or arithmetic units using AI/ML techniques through design generation. It explores how the authors represented the design for input to a neural network, whether the generation was performed directly at the RTL level or via a proxy/template, if the process was iterative involving repeated training and design generation, and any efforts made to improve the synthesis aspect.
